mode.description: deposit: part of the price (fixed amount, else percent); full: the service's whole price.

percent.description: Deposit as a percent of the service price, used when no fixed amount is set.

amount.description: Fixed deposit per booking in major units (capped at the service price); in full mode, the price of services without one.

currency.description: ISO currency (lowercase) of the amount and of services without a currency.

holdMinutes.description: Stripe Checkout session lifetime; the time stays held this long (plus 5 minutes) while the customer pays.
